title: Single-to-Album Follower Lift
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:streaming release_format=* follower_lift=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(follower_lift) as metric by _time release_format
| sort 0 _time release_format
description: Trends monthly follower lift by release format for audience growth.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether audience growth are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `release_format` on `music:streaming` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly follower lift.
visualization: Line chart of monthly follower lift by release format.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how follower lift changes month by month for each release format so you can see whether audience growth are heading the right way.
